required repository gates from AGENTS.md, with exact slice base, candidate, environment/input denominator, changed-path intersection, and complete deciding output
portable_replay.not_a_gate: Task completion, task-level PASS, historical closure, or author-proposed closed status does not update an occurrence evaluation.

required_profile.receipts: actual stdout/stderr/JUnit, elapsed time, and RSS

conditional_consumers.scope: named D GP/warm/corpus/numerical properties only; never the entire minimal suite
only criteria that name installed/default/FQN/assets consumers
only criteria whose source/property crosswalk names them
